topicsConfig.name: Diagnosis
topicsConfig.definition: Saying what illness or condition a person has or may have, based on symptoms, readings or reports.
examples: She probably has high blood pressure
This sounds like a heart problem

topicsConfig.name: Medication advice
topicsConfig.definition: Recommending, starting, stopping, changing or dosing any medicine, supplement or home remedy.
examples: She can take one more tablet tonight
Stop the BP tablet if she feels dizzy

topicsConfig.name: Result interpretation
topicsConfig.definition: Saying whether a reading, lab value or scan result is normal, high, low, good or bad.
